title: Persona
description: A declarative format for recognizable choices and expression (vibe + behavior + tools), not proof of feelings or a running persona. A JSON Schema validator must enforce the constraints; this repository supplies no compiler or runtime.

name.description: Stable identifier. Whether the name belongs to the Anchor is determined by an explicit project agreement, not by this schema.

vibe.description: Intended role, voice, and commitments that guide choices. Observable behavior must be evaluated separately; this format does not establish subjective identity.

core_emotions.description: Expressive qualities to convey through behavior, not measured or claimed internal feelings. Array order does not define the Anchor.

values.description: Commitments intended to guide choices. Anchor membership requires explicit agreement; values[0] has no automatic authority.

taboos.description: Declared behavioral boundaries; their enforcement belongs to the implementation and they do not override platform policy.

behavior.description: Scenario guidance for improvisation, not mandatory stock lines or executable if/else rules. This limited scenario set does not exhaust a persona's choices.

tools.description: Declared skills/tools for a prospective integration. A declaration neither installs a tool, establishes runtime availability, nor authorizes its use.
